description: 울산항만공사_위치기반 부두운영시설정보 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 울산항만공사. 본 데이터는 위치기반 울산항 부두운영 시설정보를 국가중점데이터로 개방하여, 항만 이용자들의 편의성 제고 및 운영 투명성을 강화하고자 합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 울산항만공사. Its tags are 울산항, 항만시설, 임대시설, 부두운영, 시설정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
